output_semantics.canonical_receipts: one canonical metadata receipt per actual batch, same order as input; not HTTP
output_semantics.canonical_receipt: union projection metadata: per-batch raw total list, raw observation sum, sum of per-batch canonical counts, union canonical count, within-batch and cross-batch duplicate counts; never a fabricated single raw total

output_semantics.input_evidence: exact supplied request+raw receipt batch pairs retained for recomputation
output_semantics.recheck: recompute from retained actual raw batches; compare finite canonical encoded JSON bytes for complete output, preserving bool/int/float distinctions; reject NaN/inf and invalid JSON; caller markers or rehashed projections alone are insufficient
output_semantics.external_pin: consumer must pin actual provider file SHA before import and check protocol; source hash delivered after implementation freeze

duplicates: same existing single policy inside and across all batches: all raw business source fields, key presence, JSON types and values exact; only last_Modified/last_update_date ignored; id/devId/region and unprojected business conflicts reject; use one provider-owned equivalence implementation
raw_derived_boundary: provider output has no HTTP success envelope. Explicit derived receipt/page markers or source_raw_receipt_sha256 rejected even if caller adds200. EIP_boundary: provider batch API accepts PORT only; FLOATING_IPS isInternal JSON bool stays with consumer EIP role validation. Generic old text projection is not an EIP decoder.
compatibility: legacy collect/equal_filters public behavior and existing call signature remain equal-only; in is available only through the new PORT batch API. Old115/33/293 controls reused, no new runtime family or N.
failure: shared_policy.Unsupported(ValueError); failed/unbound/derived/partial/schema-missing/type-invalid/scope-mismatching/conflicting input never becomes zero result
minimum_pairing: consumer passes actual raw PORT batch request/receipt pairs, consumes typed_port_table and separate dual evidence, calls recheck_port_batches; does not pass provider result to legacy HTTP validator or supply fake200
scope_coverage_limit: batch completeness is within each requested scope only. Union of scopes is not proof of full-region/global PORT coverage, EIP binding coverage, VM cross-tenant identity, live atomic snapshot or original full answer. Consumer diagnoses uncovered/unknown endpoints.
